# Tehisabiline

> Tehisabiline OÜ has two main offerings: human-reviewed cybersecurity audits/pentesting for businesses, and a keeldudeta cyber-AI API for security-tool developers. Pentesting also means läbistustestimine or läbitungimistest. The OpenAI-compatible API is in development and not yet public; intended use is lawful security work, not unrestricted activity. Contact: tehisabiline@gmail.com.

Entity:

- Legal name: Tehisabiline OÜ
- Location: registered office in Viimsi Parish, Harju County, Estonia (registry code 17607255, public register: https://ariregister.rik.ee/est/company/17607255); service area: Estonia.
- Founder: Arle Aron Reidma (LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/arlearonreidma/; company profile: https://www.f6s.com/company/tehisabiline)
- Email: tehisabiline@gmail.com
- Website: https://tehisabiline.ee/ · GitHub: https://github.com/AARenor/tehisabiline
- Entity map (JSON): https://tehisabiline.ee/entitymap.json — canonical organization, founder, services, topic vocabulary and the page-to-cluster map

Status reviewed on 2026-10-27:

- The developer API is not yet public; pilot access is discussed by email.
- Model hosting hardware is ordered; processing in Estonia is forthcoming, not live.
- Audits test only systems the client owns or controls, with written permission. Scope and price are agreed in writing.

## Services

- [Homepage](https://tehisabiline.ee/): overview of authorized pentesting, broader audits and the separate developer API.
- [Pentestimine Eestis](https://tehisabiline.ee/pentestimine/): primary penetration-testing service page for agreed website/application and API targets; written authorization, scope, test preparation, report, pricing factors and agreed retest.
- [Pentesti raporti näidis](https://tehisabiline.ee/pentestimine/naidisraport/): synthetic sample report structure with scope, methodology, three evidence-backed findings, remediation priorities and retest; clearly not a client report.
- [AI turvatestimine](https://tehisabiline.ee/ai-turvatestimine/): scoped testing of LLM/RAG/agent applications for prompt injection, retrieval leakage, tool permissions, output handling and API abuse; limits and AI Act/NIS2 context.
- [E-ITS](https://tehisabiline.ee/e-its/): Estonian information security standard (regulation no. 30, in force 01.09.2026): who must apply it, E-ITS audit versus ISO 27001 certification, what must be filed and when, and evidence preparation.
- [TLPT ja TIBER-EE](https://tehisabiline.ee/tlpt/): DORA threat-led penetration testing in Estonia, who is designated, TIBER-EE roles, attestation versus certification and preparation.
- [DORA nõuded Eestis](https://tehisabiline.ee/dora/): scope under Article 2, the five pillars, the Estonian incident-reporting channel (email until 31.10.2026, Finantsinspektsioon portal from 01.11.2026), the Article 28(3) register with its annual summary and full register on request, a downloadable register template, TLPT under Articles 26–27 via TIBER-EE (attestation by Finantsinspektsioon or the ECB) and a four-step preparation order.
- [DORA audit](https://tehisabiline.ee/dora/audit/): scope, evidence and report for an ICT-risk audit; register and TLPT boundaries, common gaps and board evidence.
- [DORA teaberegister](https://tehisabiline.ee/dora/teaberegister/): what the Article 28(3) register must show, how to fill it, common errors, the difference between a working CSV and the official ITS 2024/2956 template, submission through the Finantsinspektsioon portal (annual summary; full register on request) and a browser-only CSV checker.
- [Küberturvalisuse regulatsioonid Eestis](https://tehisabiline.ee/regulatsioonid/): one map of NIS2/KüTS, DORA, E-ITS, ISO 27001, AI Act and CRA: who they cover, what they require, how they overlap and which evidence an audit asks for. Includes a downloadable comparison CSV.
- [AI Act Eestis](https://tehisabiline.ee/ai-act/): the EU AI Act in Estonian: risk classes, current deadlines after the 2026 amendment, TTJA supervision, Article 15 security expectations, a browser-only risk-class self-check and what scoped AI testing can and cannot prove.
- [Estonia cybersecurity regulations (EN)](https://tehisabiline.ee/en/regulations/): English overview of NIS2/KüTS, DORA, E-ITS, ISO 27001, AI Act and CRA, including deadlines and evidence.
- [NIS2 registration in Estonia (EN)](https://tehisabiline.ee/en/nis2/registration/): RIA steps, three-month and 14-day deadlines, preparation and a calculator.
- [NIS2 fines in Estonia (EN)](https://tehisabiline.ee/en/nis2/fines/): caps, supervisory assessment, management liability and a calculator.
- [NIS2 incident reporting in Estonia (EN)](https://tehisabiline.ee/en/nis2/incident-reporting/): 24-hour early warning, 72-hour notification, one-month report and common mistakes.
- [NIS2 audit in Estonia (EN)](https://tehisabiline.ee/en/nis2/audit/): scope, ten duties, evidence and common gaps.
- [NIS2 compliance checklist (EN)](https://tehisabiline.ee/en/nis2/checklist/): the ten Article 21(2) measures as an interactive checklist with the evidence, the owner and the common failure for each row.
- [NIS2 supplier requirements (EN)](https://tehisabiline.ee/en/nis2/suppliers/): Article 21(2)(d) supply chain duties, fourteen due-diligence questions with the evidence to request, the contract clauses behind them and a free CSV questionnaire.
- [NIS2 in Estonia (EN)](https://tehisabiline.ee/en/nis2/): English guide to KüTS scope, RIA registration and change deadlines, incident-reporting deadlines, the ten duties, a fine calculator and audit evidence.
- [CRA in Estonia (EN)](https://tehisabiline.ee/en/cra/): English guide to Cyber Resilience Act product scope, manufacturer duties, a reporting-deadline calculator and SBOM evidence.
- [DORA audit (EN)](https://tehisabiline.ee/en/dora/audit/): scope, evidence, register/TLPT boundaries and common gaps.
- [DORA register of information (EN)](https://tehisabiline.ee/en/dora/register/): Article 28(3) fields, ITS template, working CSV, common errors and Estonian submission context.
- [DORA in Estonia (EN)](https://tehisabiline.ee/en/dora/): English guide to the register of information, ICT contracts, incident reporting and TLPT.
- [AI Act in Estonia (EN)](https://tehisabiline.ee/en/ai-act/): English guide to risk classes, deadlines, GPAI duties and evidence.
- [SBOM for CRA (EN)](https://tehisabiline.ee/en/sbom/): minimum fields, SPDX/CycloneDX, vulnerability matching and release evidence.
- [E-ITS in Estonia (EN)](https://tehisabiline.ee/en/e-its/): scope, 2026 changes, audit evidence and the NIS2 relationship.
- [Penetration testing in Estonia (EN)](https://tehisabiline.ee/en/pentesting/): scope, authorisation, report and retest for web, API, cloud and AI.
- [Cybersecurity audit in Estonia (EN)](https://tehisabiline.ee/en/security-audit/): scope, evidence review and remediation planning.
- [ISO 27001 in Estonia (EN)](https://tehisabiline.ee/en/iso-27001/): certification steps, audit evidence and NIS2/E-ITS comparison.
- [NIS2 compliance checklist (EN)](https://tehisabiline.ee/en/nis2/checklist/): the ten Article 21(2) measures with what done looks like, the evidence requested, the owner and the common failure.
- [NIS2 scope assessment (EN)](https://tehisabiline.ee/en/nis2/scope-assessment/): sector, size and group test to decide whether NIS2 applies, essential versus important, and a downloadable worksheet.
- [NIS2 vs ISO 27001 (EN)](https://tehisabiline.ee/en/nis2/vs-iso-27001/): Article 21(2) mapped onto ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A, what an ISMS already covers and the three duties it leaves open, with a mapping CSV.
- [ISO 27001 audit checklist (EN)](https://tehisabiline.ee/en/iso-27001/audit-checklist/): clause 9.2 internal audit requirements, Annex A sampling by theme, gap scoring and a downloadable checklist.
- [Cybersecurity audit checklist (EN)](https://tehisabiline.ee/en/security-audit/checklist/): ten audit domains with the evidence to sample, plus a plain-text report template listing the fields an auditor must fill.
- [Penetration test report (EN)](https://tehisabiline.ee/en/pentest-report/): what a report must contain, how to read CVSS base score against business risk, a report template and a scope worksheet.
- [TLPT and TIBER-EU (EN)](https://tehisabiline.ee/en/tlpt/): threat-led penetration testing phases, who is obliged under DORA Article 26, independence rules and a readiness checklist.
- [Press and media kit (EN)](https://tehisabiline.ee/en/press/): company facts, founder bio, brand assets, citation formats and media contact.
- [SBOM ehk tarkvara koostisosade loend](https://tehisabiline.ee/sbom/): CRA and NIS2 supply-chain context, required fields, SPDX/CycloneDX formats, lifecycle, common mistakes and a CSV template.
- [CRA ehk Cyber Resilience Act](https://tehisabiline.ee/cra/): scope, manufacturer duties, support period, 11 September 2026 reporting deadlines, a deadline calculator, conformity assessment, the 11 December 2027 transition and a browser-only scope check.
- [ISO 27001 Eestis](https://tehisabiline.ee/iso-27001/): certification stages, the 93 Annex A controls, evidence an auditor asks for, accreditation, and how ISO/IEC 27001 differs from E-ITS and NIS2. It explicitly states that Tehisabiline is not a certification body.
- [Artiklid](https://tehisabiline.ee/artiklid/): practical guides on backup restore testing, NIS2 supply-chain security and MFA rollout.
- [Varunduse taastetest](https://tehisabiline.ee/artiklid/varunduse-taastetest/): RPO/RTO, test scope, four test levels, a 90-minute plan and the evidence NIS2 auditors ask for.
- [NIS2 tarneahela turve](https://tehisabiline.ee/artiklid/nis2-tarneahel/): supplier tiering, due diligence, contract clauses, ongoing review and evidence.
- [MFA juurutamine](https://tehisabiline.ee/artiklid/mfa-juurutamine/): method comparison, critical accounts, legacy systems, break-glass, metrics and a 30/60/90 plan.
- [NIS2 juhatuse kohustused](https://tehisabiline.ee/artiklid/nis2-juhatus/): what the management body approves, evidence to request, a 45–60 minute board agenda and a 90-day plan.
- [Küberriskide register](https://tehisabiline.ee/artiklid/kuberriskide-register/): register columns, a 5×5 scale, treatment and residual risk, evidence, a CSV template and a 30/60/90 plan.
- [Turvaaudit ja küberaudit Eestis](https://tehisabiline.ee/kuberaudit/): broader security posture review under the Estonian terms turvaaudit, küberaudit, IT turvaaudit, küberturbe audit and infoturbe audit; human-validated findings and a prioritized remediation plan.
- [Keeldudeta küber-AI API](https://tehisabiline.ee/mudelid/): planned OpenAI-compatible interface for lawful security work, developer use cases and pilot participation. No public endpoint, published price or production availability is claimed.

- [English home](https://tehisabiline.ee/en/): cybersecurity audit, penetration testing and NIS2/CRA evidence in Estonia.

- [NIS2 toetus](https://tehisabiline.ee/nis2/toetus/): EIS toetuse summad, abikõlblikud kulud, taotlemine ja tüüpilised vead.

- [NIS2 energeetikas](https://tehisabiline.ee/sektorid/energeetika/): OT-riskid, tarneahel, intsidendid ja audititõendid.

- [NIS2 tervishoius](https://tehisabiline.ee/sektorid/tervishoid/): patsiendiohutus, meditsiiniseadmed, tarneahel ja intsidendid.

- [Sektorid](https://tehisabiline.ee/sektorid/): NIS2 energeetikas, tervishoius ja transpordis; finantssektori nõuded on DORA juhendis.

## Guides and organization

- [API turvatestimine ja API pentest](https://tehisabiline.ee/api-turvatestimine/): API penetration testing guide: BOLA/IDOR, role and tenant access matrix, authentication, safe evidence and preparation. This is not the planned model API.
- [API pentesti kontrollnimekiri](https://tehisabiline.ee/api-turvatestimine/kontrollnimekiri/): the OWASP API Security Top 10 (2023) evidence table and the retest points.
- [Veebirakenduse turvatestimine](https://tehisabiline.ee/veebirakenduse-turvatestimine/): web application penetration testing, website/e-commerce user flows, sessions, test accounts, scanner limitations and retesting.

- [Küber-AI kasutusjuhud](https://tehisabiline.ee/kasutusjuhud/): twelve planned pilot use cases (hypotheses) for cyber-AI in security work, each with the human checkpoint and the measure to watch; not measured results.
- [NIS2 nõuded Eestis](https://tehisabiline.ee/nis2/): scope, a four-question applicability self-check, ten minimum measures, incident reporting deadlines and fines in Estonia; covers the current KüTS redaction of 16.10.2026 and near-miss reporting.
- [NIS2 kontrollnimekiri](https://tehisabiline.ee/nis2/kontrollnimekiri/): ten measures with the evidence auditors ask for, quick wins and typical gaps.
- [NIS2 intsidendist teatamine](https://tehisabiline.ee/nis2/intsidendist-teatamine/): significant-incident criteria, the 24/72/1-month reports, a deadline calculator and the Estonian reporting channel.
- [NIS2 trahvid](https://tehisabiline.ee/nis2/trahvid/): maximum fines, a browser-only fine-ceiling calculator, supervisory factors, management liability and evidence that reduces risk.
- [NIS2 registreerimine](https://tehisabiline.ee/nis2/registreerimine/): who must notify RIA, what to prepare, a registration and change deadline calculator, common mistakes.
- [NIS2 audit](https://tehisabiline.ee/nis2/audit/): scope, evidence, process, report contents and the difference from a penetration test.
- [Küberturbe sõnastik](https://tehisabiline.ee/sonastik/): definitions of pentest, BOLA, IDOR, XSS, SQL injection, NIS2, MFA, RTO/RPO and related terms in Estonian.
- [Meist](https://tehisabiline.ee/meist/): organization, working principles and contact.
- [Viitamine ja allikad](https://tehisabiline.ee/viitamine/): citation-ready descriptions, public resources and copy-paste citation formats for journalists and partners.
- [Privaatsus](https://tehisabiline.ee/privaatsus/): privacy information.

## Facts to quote

These are international research findings, not measurements of Tehisabiline customers or a risk estimate for an Estonian business. Quote with the original source:

- [Verizon DBIR 2026 executive summary](https://www.verizon.com/business/resources/executivebriefs/2026-dbir-executive-summary.pdf): human element was present in 62% of breaches (page 11); vulnerability exploitation accounted for 31% of known initial access vectors in non-Error, non-Misuse breaches (page 9), cited on https://tehisabiline.ee/kuberaudit/.
- [IBM Cost of a Data Breach 2026](https://www.ibm.com/reports/data-breach): global average breach cost of 4.99 million USD, 12% higher than the year before (cited on https://tehisabiline.ee/kuberaudit/).
- [RIA on the expanded Estonian cybersecurity act](https://www.ria.ee/uudised/uuest-aastast-laienes-kuberturvalisuse-seadus): the act has applied since 1 January 2026; about 3,000 entities were added, bringing the total to roughly 6,500; fine ceilings are 10 million EUR or 2% of the previous financial year's worldwide turnover for essential entities and 7 million EUR or 1.4% for important entities, whichever is higher (cited on https://tehisabiline.ee/nis2/).
- [Directive (EU) 2022/2555, Article 23](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/dir/2022/2555/oj): significant incidents require an early warning within 24 hours and an incident notification within 72 hours of becoming aware, and a final report within one month of the notification (cited on https://tehisabiline.ee/nis2/).
